newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt offers 4 bln pounds worth of treasury bonds.
newsitem.headline: Egypt offers 4 bln pounds worth of treasury bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt said it would offer four billion pounds worth of treasury bonds for subscription next week, newspapers said on Tuesday.
The seven-year bonds will carry a fixed interest of 11 percent, one percent less than the first tranche, they added. Interest will be paid twice a year, on April 1 and October 1.
The central bank will accept applications between September 8 and 30.
Bonds will be issued in denominations ranging between 1,000 and one million pounds.
The central bank governor, Ismail Hassan, was quoted last week as saying the bonds would be listed on the Egyptian stock exchange three months after the issue.
The first tranche, issued in April 1995, had a five-year maturity, was worth three billion pounds and paid a fixed 12-percent interest.
